answer: Each agent must stake compute that solves a unique sonnet-hashed puzzle, and the solution is logged in a shared lagoon ledger. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to a scarce physical resource. Duplicate identities collapse into a hollow shell because forging a new key requires redoing the full puzzle at real energy cost, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
